import pandas as pd

def is_excluded(status):
    s = status.strip()
    return s in ("hủy đơn", "Đã hủy", "trả lại", "Hoàn trả")

# Load order details (revenue = sum of Thành tiền per eligible order)
d1 = pd.read_excel("DanhSachHoaDonChiTiet_1.xlsx", sheet_name="Sheet1", usecols="A,I")
d1.columns = ["ma_hoadon", "thanh_tien"]
d1["thanh_tien"] = pd.to_numeric(d1["thanh_tien"], errors="coerce")

d2 = pd.read_excel("DanhSachHoaDonChiTiet_2.xlsx", sheet_name="Sheet1", usecols="A,I")
d2.columns = ["ma_hoadon", "thanh_tien"]
d2["thanh_tien"] = pd.to_numeric(d2["thanh_tien"], errors="coerce")

details = pd.concat([d1, d2], ignore_index=True)
details["revenue"] = details.groupby("ma_hoadon")["thanh_tien"].transform("sum")

# Load orders
o = pd.read_excel("DanhSachHoaDon.xlsx", sheet_name="Sheet1", usecols="A,B,J")
o.columns = ["ma_hoadon", "thoi_gian", "trang_thai"]
o["date"] = pd.to_datetime(o["thoi_gian"], dayfirst=True)

# Revenue per month for eligible orders (not cancelled, not returned)
rev = details[details["revenue"] > 0].merge(o, on="ma_hoadon", how="left")
rev = rev[~rev["trang_thai"].str.strip().isin(["hủy đơn","Đã hủy","trả lại","Hoàn trả"])]
rev["month"] = rev["date"].dt.to_period("M")
monthly = rev.groupby("month")["revenue"].sum()
print(monthly[("2026-04","2026-06")])
